source.subject: The Golden Ticket #90: Events to book right now
source.label: Golden Ticket #90

events.title: Cutty Sark Sea Shanty Festival 2026
events.price: Free with Cutty Sark admission (adults £22, 4–15s £11, under-4s free)
events.blurb: A day of joyful maritime music marking the tea clipper's 157th birthday.

events.title: Cartoon Christmas Loop
events.blurb: Drop-in screenings of vintage Christmas cartoons on a relaxed continuous loop.

events.title: The Elf Factory
events.when: 1 to 6 December 2026, various start times (see website)
events.blurb: Three eccentric elves bring science and elf magic to their factory.

events.title: A Gruffalo Gala with Axel Scheffler
events.blurb: An evening with the Gruffalo illustrator: live drawing, stories, a Gruffet and clay modelling.

events.title: Siegfried & Joy: Las Vegas for Kids
events.blurb: A sparkling family magic show full of tricks, silly surprises and illusions.

events.title: The Three Little Pigs
events.when: 8 to 13 December 2026, various start times (see website)
events.blurb: Puppets, music and comedy as the pigs test which home is wolf-proof.

events.title: A Christmas Wish
events.when: 13 to 20 December 2026, various start times (see website)
events.blurb: A gentle dance show with Fern the Christmas Fairy and Eggnog the Elf for little ones.

events.title: Pinocchio
events.when: 15 to 20 December 2026, various start times (see website)
events.blurb: Puppetry and shadows tell Pinocchio's tale as a carpenter's tools come alive.

events.title: There's a Monster in Your (Christmas) Show
events.when: 22 to 28 December 2026, various start times (see website)
events.blurb: Tom Fletcher's interactive musical with Little Monster and a festive Elf twist.

events.title: The Ultimate Bubble Show
events.when: 30 December 2026 to 3 January 2027, various start times (see website)
events.blurb: A bubbleologist builds bubble sculptures and chases the elusive square bubble.

events.title: Mountbatten Festival of Music 2027
events.blurb: Royal Marines bands perform with spectacular lighting, including a Saturday matinee.

events.title: Family Classics: A Space Exploration
events.blurb: A 45-minute space-themed classical concert with Holst, Star Wars and Wallace & Gromit.
